research_boundary: Research infrastructure for in silico materials science discovery. Outputs are research artifacts. No regulatory certification claims. No clinical or human-subject use. ITAR / weapons applications are out of scope (Meta UMA Acceptable Use Policy and operator policy).
name: Phase 0 extracted properties for Li-Mg-Zr-Cl halide family seed
purpose: Phase 0 extraction fixture for the pre-registered novel-challenge seed (PRD §Scope Li2.2Mg0.1Zr0.9Cl6). Captures the Li3MCl6 family conductivity benchmarks; the seed itself is novelty_status=pending.
notes: DOIs are real. Numeric values are PROXIES from the Li3MCl6 family (e.g., Li3InCl6, Li3YCl6) and NOT measurements of the specific Li2.2Mg0.1Zr0.9Cl6 composition (which has no published characterisation; that's why it's a 'pre-registered novel-challenge seed' per PRD §Scope). verified=false until lead agent confirms each numeric value against the cited paper.
